notes: Options of deployment/build-vendor.sh limesuiteng kept (BUILD_GUI/CLI/DOCS/UNIT_TESTS/AMARISOFT/GNURADIO/HDSDR=OFF, SOAPYSDR=ON, UDEV/FIRMWARE install OFF); every other option the pinned tree declares is set to its upstream default.

Three deliberate non-defaults: BUILD_DRIVERS=OFF (la9310_limesdr 0.2.1 and la9310_uart_module 1.0.0 are their own DKMS components in sources.lock.json and need linux-headers-6.18.2-4-qcom, not this chroot); BUILD_LEGACYAPI=OFF (build/07 section 10: only when a consumer needs it); RPATH automation OFF as in the upstream debian/rules, so no RPATH enters a system library.
LIMESUITENG_USB_FX3/FTDI stay at their upstream ON default (USB boards, not on this device); turning them off is a review choice of the open Lime TX audit.

deploy.py verify_build still rejects every Lime runtime library until the complete native/raw-register TX audit (sources.lock.json release_blockers) is REVIEWED; this build proves only that the patched tree compiles and packages on arm64.
